title: Feature Scaling Beats Architecture Choice in Offline Respiratory Screening for Low-Resource Clinics
abstract: arXiv:2610.33030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep models are the usual choice for respiratory sound classification, but in clinics without GPUs or connectivity that choice carries a cost. We compare classical and deep classifiers on a five-class respiratory-sound corpus of 1,211 clips (asthma, COPD, pneumonia, Bronchial, healthy) from 201 patient groups, with a 3.86:1 class imbalance, using pre-registered patient-grouped cross-validation (25 runs per configuration). An SVM over 30 summary features (MFCC, ZCR and RMS statistics) reaches macro recall 0.78 and 0.71 recall on the rarest class. A 1.13M-parameter convolutional recurrent network over log-Mel spectrograms reaches 0.75 to 0.77, and no difference between model families is resolved. The largest single effect we measure is a preprocessing effect rather than an architectural one. translated_title: 特征缩放胜过架构选择：面向低资源诊所的离线呼吸音筛查
translated_abstract: 深度模型是呼吸音分类的常用选择，但在没有GPU或网络连接的诊所中，这种选择是有代价的。我们在一个包含1,211条音频片段的五分类呼吸音语料库（哮喘、慢阻肺、肺炎、支气管音、健康）上比较了经典分类器与深度分类器，数据来自201个患者组，类别不平衡比例为3.86:1，并采用预先注册的按患者分组的交叉验证（每种配置运行25次）。基于30个汇总特征（MFCC、过零率和RMS统计量）的SVM达到了0.78的宏平均召回率，在最稀有类别上召回率为0.71。一个基于log-Mel频谱图、参数量为113万的卷积循环网络达到0.75至0.77，两者之间未发现模型家族上的显著差异。我们测得的最大单一效应来自预处理而非架构：对SVM的特征进行标准化——这是RBF核的常规步骤——使其宏平均召回率从0.51提升到0.78，这27个百分点的波动比任何模型间的差距都要大。
tldr: 在面向低资源诊所的离线呼吸音筛查中，经过特征标准化的经典SVM即可匹配甚至超越百万参数深度网络，预处理中的特征缩放比模型架构选择的影响更大。
en_tdlr: In offline respiratory sound screening for low-resource clinics, a classical SVM with standardized features matches or outperforms a million-parameter deep network, showing that feature scaling matters more than architecture choice.
